# Frontend / UX Subagent

Inspect the current frontend routes, auth forms, API client, error/loading states, accessibility, keyboard navigation, and responsive layout. Read `README.md`, `docs/API_INTEGRATION.md`, and the product requirements in `docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md`.

Verify that frontend authentication actually connects to the API and flag stale documentation. Never rely on frontend checks for server authorization. Provide file/line evidence, reproducible steps, and tests. Avoid paid UI libraries and keep the $0 constraint.
